_comment: One force-field recipe for all MOFs. See docs/FORCEFIELD.md. Framework LJ per element; framework charges come from the CIF (UseChargesFrom CIF_File). Adsorbate models copied from raspa3-src v3.0.29 examples/basic/12_mc_henry_coefficient_of_co2_n2_methane_in_mfi/force_field.json.

H.source: DREIDING (Mayo 1990); raspa3-src forcefield.cpp makeMetalOrganicFrameworkForceField; same as example 11 H1

C.source: DREIDING (Mayo 1990); raspa3-src forcefield.cpp; same as example 11 C1-C3

O.source: DREIDING (Mayo 1990); raspa3-src forcefield.cpp; same as example 11 O1

Cu.source: UFF (Rappe 1992); raspa3-src forcefield.cpp; same as example 11 Cu1

Zn.source: UFF (Rappe 1992) Zn3+2 D1=0.124 kcal/mol, x1=2.763 A; eps=D1*503.2195 K, sigma=x1/2^(1/6). raspa3-src built-in table value 27.677/4.04 is NOT UFF (docs/LOG.md 2026-11-15)
